A Resonant monster hums with power, marked [Resonant] and wrapped in a shield of light.

Killing one raises the soul crystal of you and of every party member near you by one stage, without using the crystal on it. You need the quest Enhance Your Weapon under way and exactly one crystal in your bag.

It has twice the HP, and when it falls to a quarter of its health its soul flees. Root, slow or stun it before it gets away, or the resonance fades.

Strangers may join the fight. Some help you; others want the soul for themselves.
At high levels a [Resonant Boss] is as strong as a raid boss, and can raise a crystal beyond what normal monsters can.
